name: Harvey N. Randall House
description:
Harvey Randall House
This Queen Anne house was built in 1898 for Tekonsha businessman Harvey N. Randall (1859-1917) and his wife, dressmaker Adell Warboys Randall (1863-1943). Randall prospered as a produce, livestock, and hardware merchant. By 1905 he established the Harvey N. Randall Company, which dealt only in hardware. Adell served as the company’s secretary-treasurer. Randall held positions as the village president,  school board trustee, and director of the First State Bank of Tekonsha.
